thread:
alex: quick sync - i ran a small canary for probabilistic demote with tenant-aware shrinkage and a short rehydrate cache. results and ops notes.

rhea: nice, top-line?

alex: ~9% token egress reduction on multi-tenant hosts over 90m. a few micro-tenants saw origin hits bump ~5%. added mitigations: write_pin_ttl=45s, ownership_state==STABLE guard, soft_rehydrate_ttl=12s.

vikram: how do you compute demote prob now?

alex: empirical-bayes shrinkage + rank/budget as before. pseudocode:

alex: ```
rate_hat = (alpha*global + n*tenant_rate)/(alpha+n)
budget = f(rate_hat)
prob = clamp(1 - rank/budget, 0, 1)
if rand() < prob and ownership_cache.is_stable(p) and now - p.last_write_ms > write_pin_ttl:
  soft_demote(p)
```

rhea: any correctness regressions?

alex: none surfaced. observed race where ownership cache lagged ~150ms; fixed by ensuring ownership_cache.age_ms > 300 before allowing demote.

vikram: ops checklist before wider rollout?

alex: add metrics: demote_attempt, demote_prob, demote_blocked_by_pin, demote_blocked_by_ownership, demote_to_origin_count; alert if demote_to_origin_count increases >3% for 10m. also start with 1% host canary (multi-tenant only).

ops-bot: deploy: canary scheduled -> hosts=canary-1..canary-3 start=2026-03-22T11:00:00Z

rhea: sgtm, open PR and pin dashboards when ready.
